scene.speaker: valentina
scene.bubble: Mateo wakes up at seven… but he always loses one sock, so he catches the bus at the last second!
scene.intro: Mateo wakes up at seven every morning, and every morning the same thing happens: he washes his face, he brushes his teeth, he gets dressed — and then he loses one sock. Valentina waits at the door with the bus tickets, looking at her watch. He always finds the sock at the last second, under the bed, and they always catch the bus by ten centimetres. What time do YOU wake up? Tell us your morning, step by step!

data.script: Valentina: Tell us about your morning, Mateo! … Mateo: I wake up at seven, when Luna jumps on my bed. … Mateo: I wash my face and brush my teeth for two minutes. … Mateo: Then the problem: today I found one blue sock and one red sock! … Valentina: So what did you wear? … Mateo: Both! Nobody looks at socks. … Mateo: I had bread with honey for breakfast and ran to the bus. … Valentina: And you caught it? … Mateo: Yes! The driver knows me. He always waits ten extra seconds.
